resources.string: Reopen a tab when it hangs (an action runs over 45 s) or the game quits unexpectedly. At most 5 times in a row per tab.
How to use tabs, keypad, macro, proxy, tab lock
Open the quick user guide? You can read it again in Settings or the in-game menu.

RUNNING GAMES • Pick a game from the list. The + button adds another tab to run several games at once.
IN-GAME MENU • Restart tab: enter a tab number, or several such as 1-6 or 1,3,5. • Lock / unlock tab: a locked tab (lock icon) cannot be closed or restarted by accident. Exit all still works. • Proxy, Key macro, Power saving and Save log are in the same menu.
KEY SYNC • In grid mode, turn on sync to send one key to many tabs. Each group has its own colour.
CHE779 KEYPAD • Opacity, key size, theme and background image are in Settings. It can type into text fields.
KEY MACRO • Record key presses and play them back x1, x10 or forever. A small floating panel can be dragged. A warning shows on first use: macros in online games may break the game rules.
AUTO-RESTART • Turn it on in Settings. It only reopens a tab that hangs or quits unexpectedly, at most 5 times in a row per tab.
UPDATES • Settings → Check for updates downloads the new version and installs over the old one; your data is kept.
